bio.text: Christine Drazan is a Republican candidate for Governor of Oregon in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary; she is also listed as a Libertarian Party candidate.
She has represented Oregon State Senate District 26 since October 2025, when county commissioners appointed her to replace Daniel Bonham.
Earlier she served in the Oregon House of Representatives, representing District 39 from 2019 to 2022 and, after winning the 2024 election, District 51.

Ballotpedia reports she holds a bachelor's degree in communications from George Fox University and previously worked as chief of staff to House Speaker Mark Simmons and as executive director of the Cultural Advocacy Coalition from 2011 to 2018.
